summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created plenty of chances but couldn't capitalize on their opportunities. Saul Shotton's late far post volley gave them hope in added time, but it wasn't enough to salvage a result marred by soft defensive free kicks and poor marking in the box. The Bach will look to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
